name: Quest reward: Normal
comment: Live (LMO_Captures.cap 2016): 5 area-quest completions (Isle of Yarr, the jail, a Pirate micro-dungeon; levels 1-3 and 30, power 100-1000) each dropped a bag of 3-4 single stars, three 25-star bundles and a health orb (78-79 stars) with QuestRewardUpdateIIR; no change with power. Script 555 (XX_Quest Completion Loot Spawner Item Normal 160904, also Grandma Visitor 637115).
